أرتخي (form VIII)
# أَرْتَخِي (ʔartaḵī) /ʔar.ta.xiː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَخَى (irtaḵā)
# أَرْتَخِيَ (ʔartaḵiya) /ʔar.ta.xi.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَخَى (irtaḵā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
